D: Maverick returns to train a group of young pilots for a near-impossible mission.
P: Serve the snacks when everyone heads to the Hard Deck bar.
S: the bar where your phone on the bar means you buy a round
Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, finished with pico de gallo, guacamole and sour cream.
Franks grilled over coals until blistered, in toasted buns with mustard, onions cooked in butter and a spoon of chilli.
Penny's bar, push-ups if you're wrong
Crisp fries loaded with bacon, melted cheese, sour cream and chives. Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C until crisp.
M: Green prawns butterflied and grilled with garlic, chilli, lemon and parsley butter, a crisp salad of cos and cucumber, and crusty bread to mop up the butter, eaten out on deck.
the crew's barbecue before the mission
Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed under the grill with barbecue sauce.
W: Toasted marshmallows and chocolate squashed between crisp biscuits by the fire. Toast 16 marshmallows over a fire or under the grill until golden.
K: phone on the bar means you buy a round
American lager in bottles straight from an ice-filled tub, lined up along the bar for the whole squadron.

s.note: the bar where your phone on the bar means you buy a round
s.how: Layer a 300g bag of corn chips with a drained tin of black beans, 200g cheddar and jalapeños and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime. Dice 2 tomatoes with onion and coriander. Spoon on with 150g sour cream.

s.note: Penny's bar, push-ups if you're wrong
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C until crisp. Fry 4 diced rashers bacon until crisp. Top the fries with 150g grated cheddar and bacon, grill 2 minutes to melt and finish with 150g sour cream and chives.

m.how: Butterfly 1kg green prawns in the shell. Brush with 80g butter melted with 3 garlic cloves, chilli, lemon zest and parsley. Grill for 2 minutes a side. Toss cos and sliced cucumber with lemon and oil. Serve with crusty bread for the butter.

w.how: Toast 16 marshmallows over a fire or under the grill until golden. Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 plain sweet biscuits and squash together.

d.note: phone on the bar means you buy a round
d.how: Fill a tub with a bag of ice and some water and bury eight 355ml bottles of American lager for 30 minutes. Line them up along the bench for the squadron and crack them open together.
